as_told.title: Rosicrucian Disney let the CIA operate under Disneyland

plain: The comedian Kurt Metzger says Walt Disney was a Rosicrucian, a member of an old secret mystical order, and that he let the CIA "do stuff" underneath Disneyland, "and that's real." Metzger says it on the show, offering it as the reason "Disney kids turn out how they do," and he does not say what the CIA did there or how he knows.
